checks.name: migration_sanity
checks.description: Deterministic check for BUILD.bazel/BUILD.gn dual-build parity: rejects target-level # @bazel2gn:skip on convertible library/binary/reference targets, rejects convertible GN targets left above the BAZEL2GN SENTINEL in BUILD.gn, and verifies //pkg:verify_bazel2gn registration in //build/bazel2gn_verification_targets.gni; when build/bazel/rules/testing/fx_test.bzl exists, also rejects GN test packages (fuchsia_unittest_package, fuchsia_test_package) duplicated by a BUILD.bazel fx_package of the same name, and GN test packages that only package C/C++ tests Bazel can build (a BUILD.bazel cc/fx_cc binary, or a GN test executable with only C/C++ sources whose deps all have a Bazel build) and use no GN-only features, which should be migrated to fx_test + bazel_test_suite; Rust tests (Bazel cannot run them on device yet) and tests of unknown language never trigger it

checks.name: gn_dep_parity
checks.description: Compares every migrated GN target's dependency labels and edge kinds with its BUILD.gn at $PLANTER_CHANGE_BASE, in every changed package that keeps a BUILD.gn (following GN groups the target newly depends on): errors when a dependency was swapped for a sibling target of the same package (e.g. a GN-only *_static wrapper carrying link settings replaced by the library it wraps), when a removed dependency carried link-affecting settings, or when a public_deps edge with public_configs became private without the configs being re-exported as all_dependent_configs (bazel2gn emits Rust deps as private GN deps); reports dependencies no target of the package uses anymore as INFO.

checks.name: gn_target_type_parity
checks.description: Verifies that a migration keeps what GN builds. With bazel2gn (BUILD.gn kept), no converted GN target may change type: a source_set() must not become a static_library() (the cc_library needs alwayslink = True) or vice versa, and no other template may change (e.g. an sdk_source_set, or a GN-only wrapper template). When a GN target is removed (full removal), the cc_library/fx_cc_library of the same name in BUILD.bazel must set alwayslink = True if and only if it was a GN source_set(). Exception: when build/bazel/rules/testing/fx_test.bzl exists, a GN test package (fuchsia_unittest_package, fuchsia_test_package, fuchsia_test) or host test (python_host_test, host_test) may become a same-named bazel_test_suite exporting its migrated Bazel tests, unless it packaged Rust tests (those stay in GN).

checks.name: visibility_audit
checks.description: Audits BUILD.bazel visibility attributes for package-level default_visibility, missing target visibility, overly narrow sprawling visibility lists (>15 entries across >=6 areas on globally-used platform libraries/test utilities that should use target-level //visibility:public or 2-3 level rollups), unjustified //visibility:public on narrow targets, redundant :__pkg__, disguised public wildcards, multi-domain umbrella wildcards, cross-area depth-2 wildcards, overbroad depth>=3 LCA wildcards, and false-positive rdeps

checks.name: build_only_scope
checks.description: Fails if the migration change (HEAD commit, uncommitted, or untracked files) modifies any non-build file (anything other than BUILD.gn/BUILD.bazel/BUILD/*.gni/*.bzl/MODULE.bazel). Migrations must not edit source code. A newly added non-shard .cml file is allowed when the nearest BUILD.bazel declares an fx_test_component whose manifest points at it (hand-written test manifest for a migrated C++ GN unittest package; a manifest including the Rust test runner shard is not allowed, since Rust device tests stay in GN).

checks.name: lint_config_parity
checks.description: Flags lint-driven source edits (removed .clone(), added #[allow]/#[expect]/NOLINT, removed use imports, let _ =) in non-build files with file:line evidence, and warns when a BUILD.bazel lint_config outside //build/config/rust/lints fails to resolve to a rust_lint_config that includes the default clippy and rustc lint sets (Bazel replaces default lints, GN appends).

checks.name: shared_config_reuse
checks.description: Flags lint-config and GN build-argument indirection and duplication in the change: new alias() targets that only re-export a rust_lint_config (or lint-named config), dict literals in changed BUILD.bazel/.bzl files that copy the default clippy/rustc lint entries owned by //build/config/rust/lints instead of loading its exported .bzl constants, dual-build lint_config labels without a same-named GN config() in the label's package (bazel2gn copies lint_config verbatim), LINT.ThenChange references newly broken by moving lint dicts, and GN declare_args() build arguments duplicated in .bzl/BUILD.bazel instead of being exported via //build/bazel:gn_build_variables_for_bazel to @fuchsia_build_info//:args.bzl with LINT.IfChange/ThenChange comments.

checks.name: bazel_minimality
checks.description: Audits BUILD.bazel and .bzl files for redundant default attributes (crate_name == name, version = "0.1.0" on internal rustc_* targets, default crate_root), single-platform srcs = select({..., "//conditions:default": []}) workarounds that should use target_compatible_with, inline-expanded GN read_file() lists missing LINT.IfChange/LINT.ThenChange, genrule commands added by the change that derive paths or arguments in the shell ($$(dirname $(location <one input>)), $$(python3 -c ...), backticks) or hard-code bazel-out/ paths instead of Bazel's predefined genrule variables ($@, $<, $(SRCS), $(execpath), $(@D), $(RULEDIR)) and Starlark values, buildifier formatting and buildifier_lint warnings, and drive-by edits to unrelated packages outside the target directory.

checks.name: cq_reachability
checks.description: Verifies that migrated test targets remain wired into group("tests") in BUILD.gn/BUILD.bazel and that Case 2 dual-build packages register //<pkg>:verify_bazel2gn. When build/bazel/rules/testing/fx_test.bzl exists, also verifies that every Bazel fx_test and host test (host_rustc_test, wrap_host_rust_test, host_py_test, host_test, host_go_test, and test_suite expansions) in a changed package is listed in a GN bazel_test_suite (fx_test in target_tests, host tests in host_tests) that is wired into group("tests"), since fx test and infra only see Bazel tests through bazel_test_suite; tests bazel2gn also generates in GN (host_go_test, with_host_unit_tests, a wrap_host_rust_test of a with_unit_tests binary) pass when GN above the sentinel references them (e.g. a Rust GN unittest package wrapping the generated :<name>_test), and exporting one that GN already runs on host is a duplicate_host_test_export error.

checks.name: confidentiality_check
checks.description: Blocks internal vendor subpaths, internal domain names, personal email addresses, user handle mentions, and reviewer/person names from being added in the change.

checks.name: build_verification
checks.description: Builds the change: `fx build` (the configured product graph, which can leave out the migrated packages' tests and many GN dependents), then `fx build <labels>` for GN targets the product graph may leave out (the changed packages' :tests groups and test binaries, and GN tests, binaries and libraries in other packages that depend on a changed package, limited to labels in the GN graph; catches GN-only link failures such as undefined operator new after a dependency label or edge changed), `fx build --host //build:bazel2gn_verifications` (BUILD.gn/BUILD.bazel drift), and `fx bazel build --config=fuchsia_platform` / `--config=host` of `//<dir>:all` for every changed directory with a BUILD.bazel (excluding `_validate_json_action` targets such as `<fidl>_validate_ir_json` from top-level `:all` so `assert_no_deps_aspect` does not crash on their scalar `data` attribute), plus commit `Test:` footer validation for consolidating to `<= 3` `Test:` lines, unconfigured GN labels, bash syntax errors (unquoted toolchain parentheses), and unexcluded `_validate_json_action` targets. Set PLANTER_SKIP_BUILD=1 to skip builds, PLANTER_BUILD_DRY_RUN=1 to list the shell-quoted commands. Also runs `fx bazel test --config=host` on the changed packages' Bazel host tests (host_rustc_test, wrap_host_rust_test, host_go_test, host_py_test, host_test), and after the GN build reports as INFO whether each exported bazel_test_suite test reached <build dir>/tests.json (fx_test is only built, never run with fx bazel test).
